target_customer: Solo founders, creators and small businesses wanting to launch and run a business without technical staff.
problem: Starting a business needs a site, incorporation, payments, marketing and operations work that small founders cannot cover.
business_model: Subscription with tiered plans (task limits, number of businesses, domains)
product_category: AI agents that launch and run small businesses

founders.name: Jacob Wright
previous_startups: AI consumer app scaled to 1M+ users (name not given)
founders.background_notes: Founding engineer and FDE manager at RunPod per YC page.

founders.name: Santiago Gomez Paz
founders.background_notes: Product manager at Turing and synthetic data researcher at MIT CSAIL per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating site generation, incorporation, payments, ads and AI teammates; mostly integration of existing APIs and LLMs.

defensibility.rationale: Website and AI business builders such as Durable and Lovable offered similar flows and general agents are easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Durable expanded to prompt to business with payments in March 2026; no acquisition of MadeThis found.

market_need_then: YC page claims over 20,000 businesses launched in 100 days and 100,000s generated (company reported, unverified).

branding.domain_note: Uses exact .com madethis.com; acquisition history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive, friendly name but generic; search for it returns unrelated results. No press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: MadeThis claims fast user growth for an AI business launching platform in Fall 2025, but no funding, revenue or exit is verified and similar tools were already shipping. The record is too early to judge the outcome.
notes: YC page says Cambree Bernkopf was previously a MadeThis co-founder and now runs Bernie Studios; she is not listed as a current founder. YC lists Castari as a related launch. Founder education not found. No funding found in Crunchbase, Extruct or Neuronfeed snippets. The only dated competitor article (Durable, March 2026) postdates the batch, so the list is empty.
